data.gender_notes: Bishakha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bishakha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bishak’, which means ‘bringer of happiness’. In Hindu mythology, Bishakha is the name of a goddess, often depicted as a shakti or manifestation of the goddess Durga. She is said to bring happiness and prosperity to those who worship her. The name Bishakha carries the meaning “Bringer of happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bishakha usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bishakha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bishakha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
